title: config_list
description: Result of bare `stride config` — the config keys that hold a value, sorted. Names only, never values: a listing is a different question from a lookup, and returning values here would be one command that dumps every secret, going around `config get`'s redaction. `redacted: true` marks the entries `config get` will refuse to show, so a caller can tell 'set, and I may read it' from 'set, and I may not' without a call per key. Keys the binary does not read (retired names, rows written by a `config set` typo made before #254 closed that door) are filtered out rather than advertised as working configuration.
